notes: Correct and thorough (including single-file roots on links, with extensive tests), but adds an unnecessary symlink-only seek-past-end special case in zip Open and a more convoluted squashfs NewObject/New retry logic than needed.
Identical to the reference implementation, plus docs and solid tests covering skip and links modes, a regular `.rclonelink` member, and the hostile-archive escape.

The core skip and suffix behaviour works, but it changes squashfs `f.file` to `o.Remote()` (computed under the old full-path root), which likely breaks nested single-file roots; zip appends the suffix after root matching, so a single-file root on `link.rclonelink` doesn't resolve; it also adds an opaque binary fixture.
Reference-equivalent implementation with the most complete tests: range/seek, List/NewObject agreement without links, a regular `.rclonelink` member, a rooted mount, and the escape case.
Same as the reference fix, with matching docs and tests; clean and minimal.

Works, including single-file link roots and stricter non-regular rejection; however, seeking past the end of a squashfs link returns EOF errors rather than clamping, Open is restructured more than needed, and the test builds the image using `os.Chdir`, which is fragile.

Production code matches the reference: zip suffixes symlinks before root matching, and squashfs names links the same way in List and newObjectNative; it adds a reasonable docs section, end-to-end escape and squashfs tests, and a basic zip test.
